title: Tomato virus that spreads by touch detected in Busan
caption:
A highly contagious virus that attacks tomatoes and peppers has been detected in Busan greenhouses. It spreads through simple contact, so experts are urging farms to limit movement to protect harvests.

Source: Koreaherald - Tomato virus that spreads by touch detected in Busan
